name: Leisure BECLA60GAK — Gas (NG) Freestanding Cooker
short_description: In stock in store at 29 Church St, Dundalk.
description: The Leisure BECLA60GAK is a 60cm double-oven gas cooker in black from the Classic range. A large 78L main oven, a 34L second conventional oven and a separate full-width gas grill give real flexibility, over four gas burners on cast-iron pan supports with a flame-supervision safety device. LPG-convertible, with an LED display and timer. A energy rated.
features: Four gas burners on cast-iron supports
